## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior or maintainability improvement.
Name the affected entry points and explain any preserved complexity or tradeoff.

## Validation

List the focused checks and applicable full-suite or packaging results. Separate
local validation, CI, conformance, and publication evidence. Explain remaining
limits or follow-up work.

## Review

- [ ] Mechanical moves, behavior changes, and API retirements are distinguishable.
- [ ] Shared rules have one owner; source-specific meaning remains explicit.
- [ ] Public imports, profile strings, CLI behavior, and documentation links were reviewed.
- [ ] Published formats, identities, or fixture bytes are unchanged, or their deliberate change is explained.
- [ ] Cross-component changes have maintainer review; changes to published meaning or identity have product-owner review.
